name: devflowforge
description: 82 reusable design and engineering skills, including safe Playwright-powered website QA auditing, TDD, performance and security.

interface.longDescription: Cross-stack toolkit with 82 independent design and engineering skills, including Playwright website QA audits, route and control inventories, accessibility checks, TDD, performance, safe deployment and browser-aware compression. The optional local QA runner needs separate installation and an approved target environment.
defaultPrompt: Use DevFlowForge to research the users and design a new accessible SaaS dashboard with wireframes, design tokens and an implementation plan.
Audit this repository across architecture, security, product UX, performance and test coverage. Select only relevant skills and cite evidence.

Implement this feature using TDD: show a failing test, make the smallest fix, rerun unit and integration checks, and confirm release gates. Offer a scoped, authorized penetration test only if appropriate.
